usedFor: TagMango holds the orders, and Sangam CRM receives a lead through “Create or Update Lead” after “New Order Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in TagMango, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A buyer is a lead worth tracking, and the action finds one by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Create Opportunity” runs only from “Course Progress Event”, so choose that trigger when you want a follow-up date set.
